name: GL_BUDGET_INTERFACE
description: GL_BUDGET_INTERFACE is used to load Budget Data to Essbase.  You must supply values for all NOT NULL columns.

columns.name: RUN_NAME
columns.description: Interface run identifier. Not validated.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Budget load status. Valid values: NEW, VALIDATED, PROCESSED, FAILED.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier. Use the Manage Primary Ledgers task to identify valid values.  Use either LEDGER_NAME or LEDGER_ID, but not both.

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Ledger name.  Use the Manage Primary Ledgers task to identify valid values.  Use either LEDGER_NAME or LEDGER_ID, but not both.

columns.name: BUDGET_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Budget interface line identifier.

columns.name: BUDGET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the budget. Use the Manage Value Sets task, value set code Accounting Scenario to identify valid values.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the accounting period. Use the Manage Accounting Calendars task to identify valid values. This must be a period of the accounting calendar used by the ledger.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the budget amount. Use the Manage Currencies task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget amount denominated using the value from the CURRENCY_CODE column.

columns.name: ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Stores positive budget amounts.

columns.name: ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Stores negative budget amounts.

columns.name: CURRENCY_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Currency type based upon CURRENCY_CODE.  Valid values: T, E. T means that the ledger currency is used by CURRENCY_CODE.  Otherwise, E is used.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Error message for unsuccessful rows.  Populated automatically.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the Validate and Upload Budgets job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the Load Interface File for Import job that created the row.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number reference from the XCC_BUDGET_INTERFACE table. Used to map budget lines between the XCC_BUDGET_INTERFACE and GL_BUDGET_INTERFACE tables.
